items.note: Fair for a 90-win roster with a real rotation. This one has Cabrera, Assad and a rehabbing Steele. Too short until two starters land.
The champs priced like a juggernaut. 103 wins and a +214 run differential are real, but repeating is hard and this price leaves nothing on the table.
Only five spots behind the Cubs. The market already sees Pittsburgh as a real NL Central threat.

futures.note: Same DraftKings board: Cubs +2500, 11th-shortest. Tender day added a backup catcher and a Triple-A reliever, not an arm. Pass until two starters land; Peralta or King plus Rogers or Taira before Dec. 1 makes +2500 worth a look.
